about: Reviewed list for places_privacy.py (owner rule of 2026-10-18; docs/places-privacy.md). Private residences, residential buildings, listings whose name is a street address, house, lot or unit number, care, shelter and treatment services, and holiday rentals (decision 48) are counted in their municipio but not drawn: their row in places.json keeps only what the counts need. 'categories' says what a name pattern means in each Overture category (with the reason); 'public' lists the listings drawn although their name matches a pattern (name, reason and, for the lodging businesses reviewed on 2026-10-18, the source checked: these are public places); 'withheld' lists listings not drawn although no pattern matches, by Overture id only, never by name. A listing in neither list is decided by the patterns, so an unreviewed match is withheld. Overture ids can change between releases: a refreshed listing then falls back to the patterns, and tests/test_places_privacy.py reports review entries that no longer match a listing.

categories.about: ambiguous: categories Meta users file homes, condominiums, housing estates and subdivisions under; there a home word (Casa, Residencia, Hacienda, Villa, Finca, Home...), an estate or building word, a lot or house number or a postcode withholds the listing unless an accommodation word or a public venue is also named. rental: businesses that rent rooms or units; there home and estate words name the business (a guest house called 'Casa ...'), but a unit or house number, a postcode or 'Urb. ...' first still withholds it. residential: always housing. home_business: services usually run from a home under the owner's name (withheld as residences). holiday_rental: holiday rentals (an entire home, cabin, cottage or apartment rented for short stays; HANDOFF decision 48): always withheld, unless 'public' lists the listing as a hotel, guest house, inn or B&B. lodging_names: the lodging categories, where a rental, stay or getaway word in the name ('... Rentals', '... Stays') names a holiday rental unless a lodging business (hotel, guest house, inn, B&B, hostel, posada, parador, resort) is also named; a holiday-rental phrase ('Vacation Rental', 'Beach House', 'Airbnb', 'Short Term Rental', 'Tiny House') names one there and in the ambiguous and rental categories. sensitive: care, shelter or treatment services (none in the tourism categories today; the name patterns catch them). Every other category is a business or public venue: only a sensitive word, a street address or unit number, or a housing word at the start of the name ('Urb. ...', 'Residencial ...', 'Parcelas ...') withholds it. unit_names: the categories hotels, B&Bs, hostels and campgrounds are filed under, where a name that rents a unit ('... Apartment', 'Casita ...', 'Penthouse ...', 'Villa 12', '... House', '... Home', '... Villa'), a run of units ('... Apartments', 'Condominio ...') or a house called 'Casa' or 'Villa' and one word, alone or followed by a town, barrio or municipio, names a holiday rental unless a lodging business is also named (real aparthotels, rental offices and guest houses are listed in 'public'). Guest houses and inns are left out: the category names the business.
